arxiv-1702-01186.title: Mitigating radiation damage of single photon detectors for space applications
arxiv-1702-01186.creator: EAElena Anisimova, BHBrendon L Higgins, JPBJean-Philippe Bourgoin, MCMiles Cranmer, ECEric Choi, DHDanya Hudson, LPLouis P Piche, ASAlan Scott, VMVadim Makarov, TJThomas Jennewein
arxiv-1702-01186.description: A 2017 arXiv research paper by EAElena Anisimova, BHBrendon L Higgins, JPBJean-Philippe Bourgoin, MCMiles Cranmer, ECEric Choi, DHDanya Hudson, LPLouis P Piche, ASAlan Scott, VMVadim Makarov, TJThomas Jennewein. Single-photon detectors in space must retain useful performance characteristics despite being bombarded with sub-atomic particles. Mitigating the effects of this space radiation is vital to enabling new space applications which require high-fidelity single-photon detection. To this end, we conducted proton radiation tests of various models of avalanche photodiodes (APDs) and one model of photomultiplier tube potentially suitable for satellite-based quantum communications.

arxiv-2103-02848.title: Axion mass in antiferromagnetic insulators
arxiv-2103-02848.creator: Koji Ishiwata
arxiv-2103-02848.description: Abstract We calculate axion potential in antiferromagnetic insulators from path integral. It is derived from the effective potential for the order parameter of the antiferromagnetic phase in insulators. Static and dynamical axions are defined consistently from the potential. Consequently antiferromagnetic/paramagnetic and topological/normal orders are classified.

arxiv-2106-06171.title: Inter-domain Multi-relational Link Prediction
arxiv-2106-06171.creator: Luu Huu Phuc(✉), Koh Takeuchi, Seiji Okajima, Arseny Tolmachev, Tomoyoshi Takebayashi, Koji Maruhashi, Hisashi Kashima
arxiv-2106-06171.description: Abstract Multi-relational graph is a ubiquitous and important data structure, allowing flexible representation of multiple types of interactions and relations between entities. Similar to other graph-structured data, link prediction is one of the most important tasks on multi-relational graphs and is often used for knowledge completion.

arxiv-2110-03649.title: Neural Networks, Inside Out: Solving for Inputs Given Parameters (A Preliminary Investigation)
arxiv-2110-03649.creator: Mohammad Sadeq Dousti
arxiv-2110-03649.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Mohammad Sadeq Dousti. Artificial neural network (ANN) is a supervised learning algorithm, where parameters are learned by several back-and-forth iterations of passing the inputs through the network, comparing the output with the expected labels, and correcting the parameters. Inspired by a recent work of Boer and Kramer (2020), we investigate a different problem: Suppose an observer can view how the ANN parameters evolve over many iterations, but the dataset is oblivious to him.

arxiv-2305-16203.title: On Computing Universal Plans for Partially Observable Multi-Agent Path Finding Conference: Proc. of the xxx International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems (AAMAS 20xx); xxx, xxx; xxx 587
arxiv-2305-16203.creator: Fengming Zhu, Fangzhen Lin
arxiv-2305-16203.description: Abstract . Multi-agent routing problems have drawn significant attention nowadays due to their broad industrial applications in, e.g., warehouse robots, logistics automation, and traffic control. Conventionally they are modelled as classical planning problems. In this paper, we argue that it is beneficial to formulate them as universal planning problems.

arxiv-2307-05708.title: Bayesian inference on the order of stationary vector autoregressions
arxiv-2307-05708.creator: Rachel L. Binks, Sarah E. Heaps, Mariella Panagiotopoulou, Yujiang Wang, Darren J. Wilkinson
arxiv-2307-05708.description: Abstract Vector autoregressions (VARs) are a widely used tool for modelling multivariate time-series. It is common to assume a VAR is stationary; this can be enforced by imposing the stationarity condition which restricts the parameter space of the autoregressive coefficients to the stationary region. However, implementing this constraint is difficult due to the complex geometry of the stationary region.

arxiv-2310-05065.title: Systematic Search for Water Fountain Candidates using the Databases of Circumstellar Maser Sources
arxiv-2310-05065.creator: Haichen Fan(范海辰), Jun-ichi Nakashima(中岛淳一), D. Engels, Yong Zhang (张泳), Jian-Jie Qiu (邱建杰), Huan-Xue Feng (冯焕雪), Jia-Yong Xie (谢嘉泳), Hiroshi Imai (今井裕), Chih-Hao Hsia (夏志浩)
arxiv-2310-05065.description: Abstract Water fountains (WFs) are thought to be objects in the morphological evolution of the circumstellar envelopes of low- and intermediate-mass evolved stars, transitioning from spherically symmetric to asymmetric shapes. We used databases of circumstellar 1612 MHz OH and 22.

arxiv-2407-12633.title: Bayesian spatial functional data clustering: applications in disease surveillance
arxiv-2407-12633.creator: Ruiman Zhong, Erick A. Chacón-Montalván, Paula Moraga
arxiv-2407-12633.description: Abstract The ability to accurately cluster contiguous regions with similar disease risk evolution is crucial for effective public health response and resource allocation. In this article, we propose a novel spatial functional clustering model designed for disease risk mapping, utilizing random spanning trees for partitioning and latent Gaussian models for capturing within-cluster structure.

arxiv-2508-05473.title: Embedding Alignment in Code Generation for Audio
arxiv-2508-05473.creator: Sam Kouteili, Hiren Madhu, George Typaldos, Mark Santolucito
arxiv-2508-05473.description: Abstract LLM-powered code generation has the potential to revolutionize creative coding endeavors, such as live-coding, by enabling users to focus on structural motifs over syntactic details. In such domains, when prompting an LLM, users may benefit from considering multiple varied code candidates to better realize their musical intentions.

arxiv-2602-04718.title: Identifying Intervenable and Interpretable Features via Orthogonality Regularization
arxiv-2602-04718.creator: Moritz Miller, Florent Draye, Bernhard Schölkopf
arxiv-2602-04718.description: Abstract With recent progress on fine-tuning language models around a fixed sparse autoencoder, we disentangle the decoder matrix into almost orthogonal features. This reduces interference and superposition between the features, while keeping performance on the target dataset essentially unchanged. Our orthogonality penalty leads to identifiable features, ensuring the uniqueness of the decomposition.

arxiv-2602-08242.title: Software Testing at the Network Layer: Automated HTTP API Quality Assessment and Security Analysis of Production Web Applications
arxiv-2602-08242.creator: Ali Hassaan Mughal, Muhammad Bilal, Noor Fatima
arxiv-2602-08242.description: Abstract Modern web applications rely heavily on client-side API calls to fetch data, render content, and communicate with backend services. However, the quality of these network interactions (redundant requests, missing cache headers, oversized payloads, and excessive third-party dependencies) is rarely tested in a systematic way.

pmc-10535537.title: Improving Power Quality in Grid-Connected Photovoltaic Systems: A Comparative Analysis of Model Predictive Control in Three-Level and Two-Level Inverters
pmc-10535537.creator: Saliha Gada, Arezki Fekik, Miroslav Mahdal, Sundarapandian Vaidyanathan, Ahmed Maidi, Ali Bouhedda
pmc-10535537.description: The Single-Stage Grid-Connected Solar Photovoltaic (SSGC-SPV) topology has recently gained significant attention, as it offers promising advantages in terms of reducing overall losses and installation costs. We provide a comprehensive overview of the system components, which include the photovoltaic generator, the inverter, the Incremental Conductance Maximum Power Point Tracking (IC-MPPT) algorithm, and the PI regulator for DC bus voltage control.

pmc-10608172.title: Effects of Transcutaneous Electrical Nervous Stimulation (TENS) on Dysphonic Patients: A Systematic Review Study
pmc-10608172.creator: Panagiotis Plotas, Angelos Papadopoulos, Eirini Tsiamaki, Maria-Dimitra Apostolou, Maria-Antonia Chaniotaki, Efthimia Ganiatsou, Eleni-Marianthi Goutzeri, Thalia Kalogeraki, Elpida Karra, Maria Malliou, Dimitra Marinitsi, Chariklia Papoutsaki, Ilianna-Stamatia Vagianou, Nikolaos Trimmis
pmc-10608172.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Background and Objectives: Transcutaneous electrical nerve stimulation (TENS), a pain-alleviating and muscle-relaxing treatment used in physio-therapeutic clinical practice, has recently appeared to be just as effective in dysphonia. This review aimed at clarifying whether TENS can be an effective practice in dysphonia therapy and/or management on its own or combined with other types of interventions and, hence, whether its practice can be a useful, more widespread establishment to speech and language therapy intervention methods.

pmc-11345928.title: Factors associated with tuberculosis drug resistance among presumptive multidrug resistance tuberculosis patients identified in a DRTB surveillance study in western Kenya
pmc-11345928.creator: Albert Okumu, James Orwa, Ruth Sitati, Isaiah Omondi, Ben Odhiambo, Jeremiah Ogoro, George Oballa, Benjamin Ochieng, Steve Wandiga, Collins Ouma
pmc-11345928.description: Multidrug-resistant tuberculosis (MDR-TB) is caused by M. tuberculosis (Mtb) with resistance to the first-line anti-TB medicines isoniazid (INH) and rifampicin (RIF). In Western Kenya, there is reported low prevalence of drug resistant strains among HIV tuberculosis patients, creating a need to determine factors associated with drug resistance patterns among presumptive MDR-TB patients.

pmc-11503252.title: Discontinuation of Cerebro-Spinal Fluid (CSF) Drainage in Acute Hydrocephalus: A Prospective Cohort Study and Exploratory Data Analysis
pmc-11503252.creator: Anand S. Pandit, Joanna Palasz, Lauren Harris, Parashkev Nachev, Ahmed K. Toma
pmc-11503252.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background: The optimal management of CSF drainage in acute hydrocephalus, in particular when to initiate drain weaning, remains uncertain. This study aimed to evaluate the impact of timing and method of drain weaning on patient outcomes. Methods: This prospective observational study in a large-volume tertiary neuroscience centre included all adult patients who required temporary CSF drainage for acute hydrocephalus of any cause between January 2020 and March 2021.

pmc-11632514.title: Osteochondroma of Distal End Radius Presenting as Carpal Tunnel Syndrome: A Case Report
pmc-11632514.creator: Sankalp Lal, Jiyalal Bairwa, Mukesh Kumar Saini, Mahendra Singh Tak, Mahesh Bhati
pmc-11632514.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Introduction:Osteochondromas are the most common benign bone tumors, typically occurring during growth. However, their occurrence in the distal radius is rare, and presentation with carpal tunnel syndrome (CTS) symptoms in pediatric patients is even rarer.Case Report:Here, we describe a unique case of an 8-year-old female who presented with CTS symptoms and was simultaneously diagnosed with an osteochondroma of the distal radius.

pmc-11653106.title: Blue light-activated 5,10,15,20-tetrakis(4-bromophenyl)porphyrin for photodynamic eradication of drug-resistant Staphylococcus aureus†
pmc-11653106.creator: Hongshuang Qin, Huaying Niu, Yanxiang Guo, Xiaoting Wang, Tao Liu, Chuanqi Zhao
pmc-11653106.description: Photodynamic therapy (PDT) has emerged as an effective way to deal with drug-resistant bacterial infections. Especially, blue light (BL) mediated PDT (BL-PDT) presents unique advantages in the treatments of skin infection due to the strong light absorption of superficial skin, weak penetration of BL and little damage to deep tissues.

pmc-11690965.title: ADVANCING HOSPICE CARE: A SCOPING REVIEW OF DECISION-SUPPORT TOOLS IN END-OF-LIFE
pmc-11690965.creator: Susanny Beltran, Shanelle Harvey
pmc-11690965.description: Hospice, known for improving end-of-life (EOL) care outcomes and reducing hospitalizations and medical expenses, faces challenges with eligibility and referral processes. This often leads to late referrals and short lengths of stays which undermine patients’ ability to fully benefit from the service.

pmc-11782046.title: Molecular insights into the interplay between type 2 diabetes mellitus and osteoporosis: implications for endocrine health
pmc-11782046.creator: Liyun Jiang, Xia Song, Li Yan, Yali Liu, Xiumei Qiao, Wen Zhang
pmc-11782046.description: BackgroundType 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) and osteoporosis are prevalent, interconnected chronic diseases that significantly impact global health. Understanding their complex biological relationship is crucial for improving patient outcomes and treatment strategies.MethodThis review examines recent research on the mechanisms linking T2DM with osteoporosis.

pmc-12446516.title: Development and Evaluation of a Culturally Targeted Apolipoprotein L1 Counseling Training Program for Transplant Clinicians: A Pilot Study
pmc-12446516.creator: Elisa J Gordon, Jessica Gacki-Smith, Dahlya Manning, Catherine Wicklund, Debra Duquette, Clyde W Yancy, Lutfiyya N Muhammad, Siyuan Dong, John Friedewald, Alexander Gilbert, Matthew Cooper, Justin D Smith, Aneesha Shetty, Akansha Agrawal
pmc-12446516.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Rationale & ObjectiveApolipoprotein L1 (APOL1) genetic testing is increasingly used to evaluate potential living kidney donors (pLDs) of African ancestry. Transplant clinicians may benefit from improving knowledge and skills in delivering APOL1 counseling.

pmc-12450656.title: Mathematical modeling of the effect of early detection in breast cancer treatment
pmc-12450656.creator: Farouk Tijjani Saad, Yusuf Ya’u Gambo, Phollakrit Wongsantisuk, Idris Ahmed, Jessada Tariboon
pmc-12450656.description: IntroductionEarly detection is a cornerstone of cancer control, yet its quantitative influence on tumor–immune interactions remains underexplored in mathematical oncology.MethodsWe formulated a nonlinear tumor–immune interaction model consisting of two coupled ordinary differential equations for tumor growth and immune response. Early detection was represented by a saturating function (Michealis-Menten term) dependent on tumor size and awareness level.

pmc-12473480.title: Enhanced Mechanical Robustness of Sprayed Cellulose Nanofibril Coatings Through Internal Crosslinking with Boric Acid
pmc-12473480.creator: Pieter Samyn, Patrick Cosemans, Erik V Van der Eycken, Guglielmo A Coppola, Peng Jia, Guangmei Xia
pmc-12473480.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The enhanced mechanical durability of sprayed nanocellulose coatings at the macroscopic level is primarily required to promote their application in demanding industrial applications with frequently exposed surfaces. In this study, different coating configurations are designed by spraying aqueous cellulose nanofiber (CNF) suspensions in combination with boric acid (BA) as an internal crosslinker and polydopamine (PDA) as an adhesive interlayer onto glass substrates.

pmc-12574604.title: FGF receptor 2 signaling in granulosa cells is required for normal female fertility in mice
pmc-12574604.creator: Takuya Kanke, Ayaka Ichikawa, Yuki Akimoto, Shunichi Matsunaga, Wataru Fujii, Tsutomu Endo, Kunihiko Naito, Koji Sugiura
pmc-12574604.description: In briefFibroblast growth factor (FGF) signaling has been implicated in ovarian follicular development in mammals, but its in vivo role in female fertility remains unclear. This study reveals the requirement of fibroblast growth factor receptor 2 (FGFR2) signaling in ovarian granulosa cells for normal female fertility in mice, likely by regulating glycolysis in cumulus cells and enhancing oocyte developmental competence.

pmc-12705725.title: Imaging pathways in spondyloarthritis: integrating radiography, ultrasonography, magnetic resonance imaging, low-dose computed tomography, and artificial intelligence methods
pmc-12705725.creator: Magdalena Z Morytko, Patrycja S Matusik, Renata Wawrzyniak, Tadeusz J Popiela
pmc-12705725.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Spondyloarthritis (SpA) refers to a family of chronic inflammatory rheumatic conditions characterized by axial and/or peripheral manifestations. Early detection of SpA is crucial for improving long-term patient outcomes and necessitates a refined diagnostic algorithm. This literature review addresses current recommendations for imaging approaches in SpA, proposes a contemporary diagnostic algorithm for suspected axial SpA, and discusses current and emerging applications of artificial intelligence (AI) in diagnosis and management.

pmc-12932134.title: Academic Anxiety and Emotional Regulation Among Students Experienced School Change
pmc-12932134.creator: Binni Singla, Mehfooz Ahmad
pmc-12932134.description: BackgroundAdolescence is a sensitive developmental stage marked by rapid physical, cognitive, and socio-emotional changes. School transitions during this period often heighten vulnerability by disrupting established routines, academic familiarity, and peer relationships. New curricula, unfamiliar teaching styles, and the challenge of building new social connections can increase academic anxiety and make emotional regulation (ER) more difficult.

pmc-13162408.title: The economic burden of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis for patients and families: a survey on out-of-pocket expenses and income loss in France
pmc-13162408.creator: Claude Desnuelle, Philippe Couratier, Philippe Corcia, Thelma Arcelin, Camille Nevoret, Anne Duburcq, Sandrine Baffert, Sabine Turgeman
pmc-13162408.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). pmc-13217412.title: LEARNER - A prospective, randomized controlled study to evaluate the effects of daily low dose aspirin in pregnant women with sickle cell disease when initiated at the first trimester versus the second trimester of the gestational period – study protocol
pmc-13217412.creator: Miguel Brito, Catarina Ginete, Tatiana Gomes, Helena Pitangueira, Manuela Mendes, Ana Furtado, Ligia Alves, Fernanda Simão, Mauer Gonçalves, Joana Morais
pmc-13217412.description: BackgroundPregnancy in women with Sickle Cell Disease (SCD) is associated with an increased risk in severe complications, such as eclampsia, pre-eclampsia, maternal death, intrauterine growth restrictions, perinatal mortality, and low birth weight. Since 50% of these patients are now living to reproductive age, the management of SCD during pregnancy has become pertinent.

pmc-13556696.title: 423. Suicidal symptoms as central nodes in late-life depression: a network analysis in older Koreans
pmc-13556696.creator: S Chang, T Y Choi
pmc-13556696.description: BackgroundLate-life depression is a major public health concern, particularly in rapidly aging societies such as South Korea, where suicide rates among older adults are among the highest in OECD countries. While network analysis has provided symptom-level insights into depressive disorders, few studies have examined DSM-based depressive symptom networks in older Asian populations using diagnostic interview data.

pmc-13582561.title: Plasma von Willebrand factor and endothelial-lineage flow-cytometry signals in acute pediatric IgA vasculitis: a cross-sectional pilot study
pmc-13582561.creator: Zichao Ding, Xianqing Ren, Hang Su, Min Tong, Xiaoqi Xu, Yingying Jiang

pmc-13584053.title: Reconstructing AF-associated atrial fibrosis: Patient-specific iPSC models, fit-for-purpose atrial microphysiological systems, and nanomedicine
pmc-13584053.creator: Jing Ni, Yi Luo, Rong Guo
pmc-13584053.description: Atrial fibrillation (AF)-associated fibrosis is a heterogeneous component of atrial cardiomyopathy that contributes to conduction slowing, anisotropy, reentry susceptibility, and reduced therapeutic responsiveness. However, translation of anti-fibrotic strategies remains limited by the biological heterogeneity of AF and by models that incompletely reproduce human atrial cell composition, mechanics, perfusion, and electrophysiology.
